text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Monday, May 7, 2018 Posted by admin on May 7th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Apple (AAPL) and Visa (V). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open UP +66 points.
Friday the Dow was up +332.36 (+1.39%) at 24,262.51.
Year-to-date the Dow is down -1.85%.
There were 29 Dow stocks up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by Apple (AAPL) +3.92%, McDonald’s (MCD) +3.09%, Disney (DIS) +2.42% and Cisco (CSCO) +1.94%.
The Dow stock loser Friday was Chevron (CVX) -0.38%.
Five Dow components have double-digit year-to-date gains : Boeing (BA), Cisco (CSCO), Intel (INTC), Microsoft (MSFT) and Visa (V).
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended mostly higher.
The national average price of gasoline is unchanged at $2.813 per gallon.
